claim: On April 4, 2025, Judge Sidney Stein denied most of OpenAI's and Microsoft's motions to dismiss.
evidence: The Court denies OpenAI's motions to dismiss the section 1202(b)(1) claims against it in the Daily News and CIR actions.
excerpt: Unlike the Daily News and CIR complaints’ detailed allegations regarding OpenAI’s removal of CMI during the process of developing its LLM training datasets, all three complaints are devoid of factual specificity to support their claims against Microsoft for violation of section 1202(b)(1). None of the allegations concerning Microsoft—including Microsoft’s partnership with OpenAI to develop Copilot and Browse with Bing, and its provision of the cloud computing system which OpenAI uses to train its models—relate to any alleged removal by Microsoft of CMI from plaintiffs’ works.
